questions.text: Which English king is famous for having six wives?
questions.explanation: Henry VIII married six times between 1509 and 1547.

questions.text: In which city is Buckingham Palace?
questions.explanation: Buckingham Palace is the royal residence in Westminster, London.

questions.text: In which year was the Battle of Hastings fought?
questions.explanation: William of Normandy defeated King Harold in 1066.

questions.text: The English fleet defeated the Spanish Armada in which year?
questions.explanation: The Armada was defeated in the summer of 1588 under Elizabeth I.

questions.text: The Great Fire of London, which began in Pudding Lane, broke out in which year?
questions.explanation: The fire burned from 2 to 6 September 1666.

questions.text: Which Tudor monarch, who reigned from 1553 to 1558, was nicknamed Bloody Mary?
questions.explanation: Mary I earned the nickname for burning Protestants as heretics.

questions.text: Which royal house did Henry VII found?
questions.explanation: Henry Tudor won the throne at Bosworth in 1485.

questions.text: Admiral Nelson was killed at which 1805 battle?
questions.explanation: Nelson died winning the Battle of Trafalgar.

questions.text: Who was British Prime Minister when war was declared on Germany in September 1939?
questions.explanation: Chamberlain led the country until May 1940.

questions.text: Who succeeded Elizabeth I on the English throne in 1603?
questions.explanation: James VI of Scotland became James I of England.

questions.text: In which year was the Battle of Bosworth Field, which ended the Wars of the Roses?
questions.explanation: Richard III died at Bosworth in August 1485.

questions.text: Which king was beheaded outside the Banqueting House in 1649?
questions.explanation: Charles I was executed after the English Civil War.

questions.text: In which year did the Acts of Union join the parliaments of England and Scotland?
questions.explanation: The Kingdom of Great Britain was created in 1707.

questions.text: Which joint monarchs took the throne after the Glorious Revolution of 1688?
questions.explanation: William and Mary were crowned in 1689.

questions.text: The Peasants' Revolt of 1381 took place during the reign of which king?
questions.explanation: Richard II was just fourteen at the time.

spares.text: Which queen reigned for 63 years until her death in 1901?
Who led the Parliamentarian cause in the Civil War and became Lord Protector?
spares.explanation: Cromwell ruled the Commonwealth from 1653 to 1658.

spares.text: Which English king, nicknamed Longshanks, was known as the Hammer of the Scots?
spares.explanation: Edward I campaigned against Scotland from 1296 until his death in 1307.
